title: Premium Billing Accounts — Schedule of Billing Periods, Due Dates and Invoice Basis
content:
Every Premium Billing Accounts arrangement bills premium on a fixed calendar set by this schedule. The schedule fixes, for each of the seven arrangements, how many months of coverage one invoice bills, the day of the month on which premium is due, how far ahead of that due date the invoice is issued, and the basis on which the premium is priced.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Months billed per invoice** — months of coverage billed per invoice.
- **Premium due day** — day of the month on which the premium for a billing period is due (the first day of the period it covers).
- **Invoice lead time** — calendar days before the due date on which the invoice is issued.
- **Partial-month billing** — coverage always starts and ends on month boundaries, so no partial-month premium is billed (whole months only).
- **Statement rounding** — amounts are rounded half up to the cent.
- **Late fee** — USD late fee on unpaid premium; 0.00 means none is charged.
- **Individual invoice basis** — how individual premium is computed: filed rates by coverage tier, meaning the plan's monthly premium for the coverage tier plus orthodontic rider premium per enrolled person; not applicable for groups.
- **Group invoice basis** — how group premium is computed: contract rates times enrolled, meaning the group contract's rate per coverage tier times the subscribers enrolled in that tier on the first of the month; not applicable for individual arrangements.

## Billing calendar by arrangement

| Arrangement | Months billed per invoice | Premium due day | Invoice lead time (calendar days) | Late fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 1 | 1 | 20 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 1 | 1 | 20 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 3 | 1 | 30 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 12 | 1 | 45 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 1 | 1 | 20 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 1 | 1 | 30 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.00 |

## Pricing basis by arrangement

| Arrangement | Individual invoice basis | Group invoice basis | Partial-month billing | Statement rounding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | filed rates by coverage tier | not applicable | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | filed rates by coverage tier | not applicable | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | filed rates by coverage tier | not applicable | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | filed rates by coverage tier | not applicable | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | filed rates by coverage tier | not applicable | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Group List Bill | not applicable | contract rates times enrolled | whole months only | half up to the cent |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | not applicable | contract rates times enrolled | whole months only | half up to the cent |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- The due day is 1 on every arrangement, so each billing period falls due on the first day of the first month it covers.
- An invoice issued with a lead time of 45 days falls 45 calendar days before that first day; an invoice with a lead time of 0 days is issued on the due date itself (the self-administered group, which reports its own enrollment).
- No arrangement charges a late fee: the figure is 0.00 throughout.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill account whose next unbilled month begins on a first of the month is invoiced for 3 whole months, 30 calendar days before that first day; a Cascade Individual Annual Prepay account is invoiced for 12 whole months, 45 calendar days before its first day.
